content.title: Data Connectors
content.query:
// Data Connector Status Distribution
let ConnectorHealth =
union
(
AzureActivity
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Azure Activity"
),
(
Usage
| where DataType == "CloudflareV2_CL"
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Cloudflare (Using Blob Container)"
),
(
CommonSecurityLog
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Common Event Format (CEF) via AMA"
),
(
Usage
| where DataType == "GoogleWorkspaceReports"
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Google Workspace Activities"
),
(
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload in ("SharePoint","OneDrive","Exchange","MicrosoftTeams")
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft 365"
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where ProductName == "Microsoft 365 Insider Risk Management"
| extend alertWasCustomized=bag_has_key(todynamic(ExtendedProperties), "OriginalProductName")
| where alertWasCustomized == false
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft 365 Insider Risk Management"
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where ProductName == "Microsoft Cloud App Security"
| extend alertWasCustomized=bag_has_key(todynamic(ExtendedProperties), "OriginalProductName")
| where alertWasCustomized == false
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps"
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "MDATP"
| extend alertWasCustomized=bag_has_key(todynamic(ExtendedProperties), "OriginalProductName")
| where alertWasCustomized == false
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Defender for Endpoint"
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where ProductName == "Azure Advanced Threat Protection"
| extend alertWasCustomized=bag_has_key(todynamic(ExtendedProperties), "OriginalProductName")
| where alertWasCustomized == false
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Defender for Identity"
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "OATP"
| extend alertWasCustomized=bag_has_key(todynamic(ExtendedProperties), "OriginalProductName")
| where alertWasCustomized == false
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Defender for Office 365"
),
(
union
(
SecurityIncident
| where ProviderName in ("Microsoft 365 Defender","Microsoft XDR")
| project TimeGenerated
),
(
SecurityAlert
| extend OriginalProductName=tostring(todynamic(ExtendedProperties).OriginalProductName)
| where (isempty(OriginalProductName) and ProductName in ("Microsoft Defender Advanced Threat Protection","Office 365 Advanced Threat Protection","Azure Advanced Threat Protection","Microsoft Cloud App Security","Microsoft 365 Defender","Microsoft Defender XDR","Microsoft Threat Intelligence"))
or (ProductName in ("Microsoft 365 Defender","Microsoft Defender XDR")
and OriginalProductName in ("Microsoft Defender Advanced Threat Protection","Office 365 Advanced Threat Protection","Azure Advanced Threat Protection","Microsoft Cloud App Security","Microsoft 365 Defender","Microsoft Defender XDR","Microsoft Threat Intelligence"))
| project TimeGenerated
)
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Defender XDR"
),
(
union
(
SigninLogs
| project TimeGenerated
),
(
AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
| project TimeGenerated
),
(
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| project TimeGenerated
)
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Entra ID"
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where ProductName == "Azure Active Directory Identity Protection"
| extend alertWasCustomized=bag_has_key(todynamic(ExtendedProperties), "OriginalProductName")
| where alertWasCustomized == false
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Entra ID Protection"
),
(
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem in ("Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence","Microsoft Emerging Threat Feed")
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Threat Intelligence"
),
(
Syslog
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Syslog via AMA"
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where ProductName == "Azure Security Center"
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Tenant-based Microsoft Defender for Cloud"
),
(
SecurityEvent
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Windows Security Events via AMA"
);
ConnectorHealth
| extend MinutesSinceLastLog = datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastSeen)
| extend Status = iff(
    isnull(LastSeen),
    "Unhealthy",
    "Healthy"
)
| summarize Count=count() by Status
| extend Percentage=round((Count * 100.0) / 17, 2)
| extend StatusOrder = iff(Status == "Unhealthy", 1, 2)
| order by StatusOrder asc
| project Status, Percentage

content.title: Total Arc Machines
content.query:
// Total Azure Arc Machines
Heartbeat
| where ResourceProvider == "Microsoft.HybridCompute"
| summarize TotalArcMachines=dcount(Computer)

content.title: Healthy Arc Machines
content.query:
//Healthy Azure Arc Machines
Heartbeat
| where ResourceProvider == "Microsoft.HybridCompute"
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
| summarize HealthyArcMachines=countif(LastSeen > ago(1h))

content.title: Stale Arc Machines

Heartbeat
| where ResourceProvider == "Microsoft.HybridCompute"
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
| summarize StaleArcMachines=countif(LastSeen < ago(1h))

content.title: Azure Arc Coverage %
content.query:
// Azure Arc Coverage %
Heartbeat
| where ResourceProvider == "Microsoft.HybridCompute"
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
| extend Status=iff(LastSeen > ago(1h), "Healthy", "Unhealthy")
| summarize Count=count() by Status
| extend Percentage=round(100.0 * Count / toscalar(
    Heartbeat
    | where ResourceProvider == "Microsoft.HybridCompute"
    | summarize dcount(Computer)
), 2)

content.title: Azure Arc Health Details
content.query:
// Azure Arc Health Details
Heartbeat
| where ResourceProvider == "Microsoft.HybridCompute"
| summarize
    LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),
    OSName=any(OSName)
by Computer
| extend MinutesSinceLastHeartbeat=datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastSeen)
| extend Status=case(
    MinutesSinceLastHeartbeat <= 60, "Healthy",
    "Stale"
)
| project
    Server=Computer,
    OSName,
    LastSeen,
    Heartbeat_Age_Min= MinutesSinceLastHeartbeat,
    Status
| order by Heartbeat_Age_Min desc

content.title: Total MDE Agents
content.query:
// Total MDE Agents
DeviceInfo
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| summarize TotalMDEAgents=count()

content.title: Healthy MDE Agents
content.query:
// Healthy MDE Agents
DeviceInfo
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| summarize HealthyMDEAgents=countif(
    SensorHealthState == "Active"
    and TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
)

content.title: Stale MDE Agents
content.query:
// Stale MDE Agents
DeviceInfo
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| summarize HealthyMDEAgents=countif(
    SensorHealthState != "Active"
    and TimeGenerated < ago(24h)
)

content.title: MDE Agent Coverage %
content.query:
// MDE Agent Coverage %
DeviceInfo
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| summarize
    HealthyMDEAgents=countif(
        SensorHealthState == "Active"
        and TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    ),
    TotalMDEAgents=count()
| extend
    HealthyPercent=round((HealthyMDEAgents * 100.0) / TotalMDEAgents, 2),
    StalePercent=round(((TotalMDEAgents - HealthyMDEAgents) * 100.0) / TotalMDEAgents, 2)
| project HealthyPercent, StalePercent
| mv-expand Status=dynamic(["Healthy","Stale"]) to typeof(string)
| extend Percentage=iff(Status=="Healthy", HealthyPercent, StalePercent)
| project Status, Percentage

content.title: MDE Agent Health Details
content.query:
// MDE Agent Health Details
DeviceInfo
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| where isnotempty(DeviceName)
| extend HoursSinceLastSeen=datetime_diff("hour", now(), TimeGenerated)
| extend Status=case(
    SensorHealthState != "Active" and TimeGenerated <= ago(24h), "Sensor Issue + Stale",
    SensorHealthState != "Active", "Sensor Issue",
    TimeGenerated <= ago(24h), "Stale",
    "Healthy"
)
| extend StatusOrder=case(
    Status == "Sensor Issue & Stale", 1,
    Status == "Sensor Issue", 2,
    Status == "Stale", 3,
    Status == "Healthy", 4,
    5
)
| order by StatusOrder asc, HoursSinceLastSeen desc
| project
    DeviceName,
    OSPlatform,
    OSVersion,
    MDEAgentVersion=ClientVersion,
    SensorHealthState,
    LastSeen=TimeGenerated,
    HoursSinceLastSeen,
    Status

| where ProductName == "Microsoft Cloud App Security"
| extend alertWasCustomized=bag_has_key(todynamic(ExtendedProperties), "OriginalProductName")
| where alertWasCustomized == false
| project TimeGenerated
),
(
Usage
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(6d))
| where DataType == "McasShadowItReporting"
| project TimeGenerated
)
| summarize Events=count() by Date=startofday(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps"
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(6d))
| where ProviderName == "MDATP"
| extend alertWasCustomized=bag_has_key(todynamic(ExtendedProperties), "OriginalProductName")
| where alertWasCustomized == false
| summarize Events=count() by Date=startofday(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Defender for Endpoint"
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(6d))
| where ProductName == "Azure Advanced Threat Protection"
| extend alertWasCustomized=bag_has_key(todynamic(ExtendedProperties), "OriginalProductName")
| where alertWasCustomized == false
| summarize Events=count() by Date=startofday(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Defender for Identity"
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(6d))
| where ProviderName == "OATP"
| extend alertWasCustomized=bag_has_key(todynamic(ExtendedProperties), "OriginalProductName")
| where alertWasCustomized == false
| summarize Events=count() by Date=startofday(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Defender for Office 365"
),
(
union isfuzzy=true
(
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(6d))
| where ProviderName in ("Microsoft 365 Defender","Microsoft XDR")
| project TimeGenerated
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(6d))
| extend OriginalProductName=tostring(todynamic(ExtendedProperties).OriginalProductName)

| project TimeGenerated
),
(
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(6d))
| where ProductName in ("Microsoft 365 Defender","Microsoft Defender XDR")
| project TimeGenerated
)
| summarize Events=count() by Date=startofday(TimeGenerated)
| extend Connector="Microsoft Defender XDR"
),
(
union isfuzzy=true
(
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(6d))
| project TimeGenerated
),
(
AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(6d))
| project TimeGenerated
),
(
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(6d))

)

SecurityAlert

Usage

Days
| join kind=leftouter (
    ConnectorActivity
    | summarize HealthyConnectors=dcount(Connector) by Date
) on Date
| extend HealthyConnectors=coalesce(HealthyConnectors, 0)
| extend UnhealthyConnectors=TotalConnectors - HealthyConnectors
| project Date, Healthy=HealthyConnectors, Unhealthy=UnhealthyConnectors
| order by Date desc
